box_contents.name: CyberBrick Beginner Hardware Kit (1 Car, 1 Remote)

description_blocks.text: Overview

Discover the ultimate tabletop logistics experience with this compact remote-controlled forklift and truck set. Despite its small size, it delivers pro-level performance with fully proportional steering and throttle control. The intricately 3D-printed details include a functional telescoping mast and rear differential for rigorous realism. Through multi-device connectivity, seamlessly toggle between vehicles for cooperative play—all in a 3D-printed miniature warehouse setting. Precision engineering meets immersive fun!
Find all files and RC Frameworks on their MakerWorld pages: Classic Holiday Edition
*For a smooth build, we recommend reviewing the assembly guide first.
Rich Detail, Smooth Build

Rich colors, charming decorations, and delightful micro-details everywhere — all optimized by the creator for smooth printing and easy assembly. Even single-nozzle printers can handle this build with no stress.
Customizable Lighting Effects
Shining golden headlights and rear light accents bring your Snowcat to life with dynamic, customizable CyberBrick lighting.
More Power, More Fun

A major upgrade from traditional 030-motor vehicles, this Snowcat utilizes 360° servos to deliver massive torque. Featuring a classic differential tank-drive system, it conquers all types of rugged terrain with ease—including real snow!
Beyond the Holiday Season

Exceptional designs transcend the calendar. Complementing the festive Christmas Snowcat, the Snowcat features a meticulously crafted Yellow Edition, ensuring a versatile option for enjoyment throughout the entire year.
Remote Control Instruction
The Model is designed to work with the CyberBrick Official Remote. Pre-configured settings have been prepared for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
* Please visit the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote on Makerworld for more details.

Important Notices
To ensure safety, please read and carefully follow the guidelines below. Minors must be under direct adult supervision when using this product.
Intended Users: This product is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under the age of 16 must be under direct adult supervision throughout use.
Firmware Safety: Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty.
Operational Safety: Do not touch the moving tracks or wheels while the device is operating to prevent pinching injuries.
Battery & Charging: DO NOT use chargers with output higher than 5V or 2A, only the officially designated battery and charger must be used. Avoid exposing the battery to high temperatures or water.

Maintenance & Storage: Before use, inspect all 3D-printed parts and sand down any sharp edges or burrs if present. Store the model and small parts in a location out of reach of children and pets to prevent choking hazards.
Our company is not liable for any equipment damage, failure, fire, or other loss caused by non-compliance with the above requirements.
Please strictly follow the safety instructions for this product.
